posts.name: Kratos13
posts.cooked:
So I was fighting the Ennead, Ra was one of the heroes with Flame Barrier.

The Deserts Wrath gets played (lowest HP villain deals everyone damage).  Nuit has the lowest HP. I choose Ra to take damage first.  Flame Barrier reacts and incapacitates/flips Nuit.

Desert Wrath contines, but then shows flipped Nuit as the source attempting to damage the other heroes.  Since she's flipped, she does 0 damage to other heroes.

Thematically this can make sense (Ra incapacitates Nuit before she can damage anyone else).  But is this correct behaviour according to the rules?

I'm thinking about Gene Bound Shackles - the villain target with the highest HP can change dynamically as you're dealing damage to multiple targets.  So with the right order, you can get multiple benefits.  Same with Smoke Bombs - hero target with lowest HP can change dynamically and you can get multiple benefits.

So my question is, after Nuit gets flipped, should Desert Wrath dynamically change to use the next villain target with lowest HP to continue to damage the rest of the heroes?

FYI, playing on iOS.

Thanks!

I believe that the process works by selecting the target (Nuit) and then fulfilling the command (deal damage).

Because Bubbles health is in the damage command it can change during the execution, any X can.

In order for a different Ennead to deal that damage it would have to work by sourcing each instance of damage.

Find lowest, deal first instance, find lowest, deal second instance, find lowest, deal third instance.

posts.name: Kratos13
posts.cooked:
There is precedence for "target with highest/lowest HP" to change dynamically as target HP changes or gets incapped.  Gene Bound shackles + Squall vs targets with similar HP.  Smoke bombs with heroes having similar HP.

There is also precendence for this to not change dynamically.  Monorail targetting two highest HP targets. Matriarch's birds targetting all but lowest or all but highest target.

Granted, all these examples refer to damage targets.  My question about Desert Wrath or Scum and Villainy pertain to damage sources.  I don't know if there is precedence for this.  Hence clarification would be nice.

 

Edit: just occurred to me that my examples of Genebound and Smoke Bombs are equipment/ongoings.  The other examples are not.  Is this the key distinguishment?  What about Claustrophobic Delusion (only lowest HP nonhero target can be damaged)?
